title: A scheme covered by affine opens of the form X_s for sections of powers of an invertible sheaf is separated
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter properties.tex (Properties of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file properties.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if a scheme X with an invertible sheaf L has, for every point, a section of some power of L whose nonvanishing locus is affine and contains the point, then X is separated (statement lines 4579-4585). The proof (proof lines 4587-4640) obtains quasi-separatedness from the affineness of intersections, applies the valuative criterion, and compares the two free rank one pullbacks of the invertible sheaf inside their base changes to the fraction field to conclude that the images lie in a common affine open. H3: a valuative argument with a module-theoretic comparison, written out in full.
